svg.title: Deployment topology and CI/CD boundaries — LibraFlow

g.text: Deployment topology and CI/CD boundaries — LibraFlow
Frontend CI: npm ci, lint, build
Production smoke check: SPA routes and public API
CD Demo: build, validate, publish to Pages
task branch -> reviewed PR -> develop -> main
Backend and frontend workflows are CI only.
On successful Production deployment, the smoke check
GETs frontend routes, OpenAPI, and the public catalog.
It verifies the app after deployment; it does not deploy it.
CD Demo publishes a separate static teaching page;
it does not deploy the app to Vercel or Render.
Confirm actual branch and environment settings
A database branch name does not prove which
connection Render uses. Check DB_URL privately.
